Crossfade alpha is premultiplied for mixing and straight in output
Upfaders Only ignores amount at endpoints and exposes both input gains
Scratch holds captured source in interior and releases at opposite endpoint
Latch 50 captures each crossing and holds source-frame changes
Scratch Fade blends frozen outgoing frame with live incoming frame

Same-frame Latch 50 threshold changes update the selected snapshot

Same-frame clock 10 to 12 to 11 clears actual Smudge feedback
Same-frame controls replace current history without feeding it back

Latch and filtered history paths retain red chroma at transparent edges
